voices.name: l00
voices.text: On a plane, they tell you <#0.2#> to put your own mask on first.
voices.caption: On a plane, they tell you to put your own mask on first.

voices.name: l01
voices.text: You have to breathe, <#0.2#> before you can help the person next to you.
voices.caption: You have to breathe, before you can help the person next to you.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: You didn't come to Earth <#0.2#> to please anyone.
voices.caption: You didn't come to Earth to please anyone.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: So be a little more, <#0.3#> selfish.
voices.caption: So be a little more, selfish.

voices.name: l04
voices.text: Not what others want to hear, <#0.2#> say what your soul wants to say.
voices.caption: Not what others want to hear, say what your soul wants to say.

voices.name: l05
voices.text: When you're full, <#0.2#> real love can finally flow.
voices.caption: When you're full, real love can finally flow.
